CHAPTER.VERS: For, look, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow on the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;
If the foundations are destroyed, What can the righteous do?
Yahweh is in his holy temple; Yahweh, his throne is in heaven; His eyes look at, his eyelids try, the sons of man.
Yahweh tries the righteous; But the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.
On the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind will be the portion of their cup.
For Yahweh is righteous; he loves righteousness: The upright will see his face.
